y.B: 草, grass, is a plant too — it grows out of the ground like 花 and 树.
y.D: 树, a tree, is a plant, the biggest of the three.

yz.A: 花是植物，和草、树是一类。
yz.B: 草也是植物，和花、树一样从地里长出来。
yz.D: 树是植物，和花、草是一类。

zh-word.q: 找出不同类的词：宇航员　飞行员　运动员　动物园
zh-word.e: 宇航员, 飞行员 and 运动员 are people — 员 at the end means a person who does that job. 动物园 is a zoo, a place: its last character is 园, a garden, not 员.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第十二课《探月》 星期一，练习4（printed p.73）
zh-word.qe: Find the word that does not belong: 宇航员 飞行员 运动员 动物园
zh-word.ez: 宇航员、飞行员、运动员都是人，"员"是做某种工作的人；动物园是一个地方，最后一个字是"园"，不是"员"。

y.A: 宇航员 is a person, an astronaut — 员 marks someone who does a job.
y.B: 运动员 is a person too, an athlete, and it ends in the same 员.
y.C: 飞行员 is a pilot, a person who flies planes; it ends in 员 like the others.

yz.A: 宇航员是人，"员"是做某种工作的人。
yz.B: 运动员也是人，最后一个字也是"员"。
yz.C: 飞行员是开飞机的人，也是"员"。

zh-word.q: 找出不同类的词：火箭　飞机　汽车　飞船
zh-word.e: 火箭, 飞机 and 飞船 all fly — up into the sky or out into space. 汽车, a car, runs along the road.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第十二课《探月》 星期一，练习4（printed p.73）
zh-word.qe: Find the word that does not belong: 火箭 飞机 汽车 飞船
zh-word.ez: 火箭、飞机、飞船都会飞，在天上或者太空里；汽车在路上跑。

y.A: 火箭, a rocket, flies — it carries spaceships and satellites up into space.
y.C: 飞船, a spaceship, flies into space — the 阿波罗号 took the astronauts to the moon.
y.D: 飞机, a plane, flies through the sky — 飞 is right there in its name.

yz.A: 火箭会飞，能把飞船、卫星送上太空。
yz.C: 飞船会飞到太空去，"阿波罗号"就是飞船。
yz.D: 飞机在天上飞，名字里就有"飞"。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：宇航员______回到了地球。
zh-word.e: 安全 means safe and sound. The 课文 says the astronauts came home with moon soil and rocks, 安全回到了地球 — back on Earth unharmed.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第十二课《探月》 星期二，练习2（printed p.73）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 宇航员______回到了地球。
zh-word.ez: "安全"是没有危险、平平安安。课文说宇航员带着月球上的泥土和石块，安全回到了地球。

y.A: 实现 means to make a dream or a wish come true; it needs the dream after it, as in 实现了梦想, not 回到.
y.B: 正式 means officially, the way China 正式开展 its moon program; nobody comes home officially.
y.D: 知道 means to know; 宇航员知道回到了地球 would say what they knew, not how they came back.

yz.A: "实现"后面要跟梦想、愿望，像"实现了梦想"，不能说"实现回到"。
yz.B: "正式"说的是一件事正式开始，像"正式开展"；回家不说"正式回到"。
yz.D: "知道"是心里明白，"宇航员知道回到了地球"说不通。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：人们很早以前就想______月亮上有什么。
zh-word.e: 知道 means to know. For a very long time people wondered what is on the moon — they wanted to know.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第十二课《探月》 星期二，练习2（printed p.73）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 人们很早以前就想______月亮上有什么。
zh-word.ez: "知道"是明白、了解。人们很早以前就想知道月亮上有什么。

y.A: 实现 is for a dream coming true; 想实现月亮上有什么 makes no sense.
y.B: 正式 means officially, as in 正式开始; it cannot stand between 想 and what people wondered about.
y.C: 安全 means safe; 想安全月亮上有什么 is not a sentence.

yz.A: "实现"说的是梦想成真，"想实现月亮上有什么"说不通。
yz.B: "正式"是正式开始、正式比赛，不能放在"想"和"月亮上有什么"中间。
yz.C: "安全"是没有危险，"想安全月亮上有什么"不成句子。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：2004年，中国______开展嫦娥探月工程。
zh-word.e: 正式 means officially, properly begun. The 课文 says that in 2004 China officially started the Chang'e moon program: 中国正式开展嫦娥探月工程.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第十二课《探月》 星期二，练习2（printed p.73）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 2004年，中国______开展嫦娥探月工程。
zh-word.ez: "正式"就是按照规定、郑重地开始。课文说：二〇〇四年，中国正式开展嫦娥探月工程。

y.A: 实现 means a dream came true; it cannot sit in front of 开展, starting something.
y.C: 安全 is the word for the astronauts coming home safely in the first sentence; the 课文 says China started its program 正式, officially.
y.D: 知道 means to know; 中国知道开展嫦娥探月工程 does not make sense.

yz.A: "实现"是梦想成真，不能放在"开展"前面。
yz.C: "安全"是宇航员平安回来用的词；课文说的是中国"正式"开展探月工程。
yz.D: "知道"是明白，"中国知道开展嫦娥探月工程"说不通。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：人类______了登月的梦想。
zh-word.e: 实现 means to make come true, and a dream is what comes true: 人类实现了登月的梦想, humankind's dream of landing on the moon came true.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第十二课《探月》 星期二，练习2（printed p.73）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 人类______了登月的梦想。
zh-word.ez: "实现"是让梦想变成真的。梦想是可以实现的：人类实现了登月的梦想。

y.B: 正式 needs an action after it, as in 正式开展; nobody says 正式了梦想.
y.C: 安全 means safe; you cannot 安全 a dream.
y.D: 知道了登月的梦想 would only mean people heard about the dream — the 课文 says the dream came true.

yz.B: "正式"后面要跟动作，像"正式开展"，没有"正式了梦想"的说法。
yz.C: "安全"是没有危险，不能"安全了梦想"。
yz.D: "知道了登月的梦想"只是听说了这个梦想；课文说的是梦想实现了。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：月亮上有什么？人们很早以前就想看个______。
zh-word.e: 看个明白 means to look until you understand. The 课文 opens the same way: long, long ago people already wanted 看个明白 what is on the moon.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第十二课《探月》 星期三，练习4（printed p.77）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 月亮上有什么？人们很早以前就想看个______。
zh-word.ez: "看个明白"就是看清楚、弄懂。课文开头就说：人们很早很早以前就想看个明白。

y.A: 宇航员 are the astronauts who went in 1969; people long before them wanted to understand the moon, not to look at an astronaut.
y.C: 植物: there are no plants on the moon, and the sentence is about wanting to see clearly what is up there.
y.D: 荒凉 is what the astronauts found much later; long ago nobody knew it yet — they only wanted 看个明白.

yz.A: "宇航员"是后来登上月球的人；很早以前的人想的是把月亮看明白，不是看宇航员。
yz.C: 月球上根本没有植物；句子说的是想把月亮上有什么看清楚。
yz.D: "荒凉"是宇航员后来才发现的；很早以前人们还不知道，只想看个明白。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：1969年，美国______成功登上月球。
zh-word.e: 宇航员 are astronauts. Someone has to step onto the moon, and in 1969 it was American astronauts: 美国宇航员第一次登上了月球.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第十二课《探月》 星期三，练习4（printed p.77）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 1969年，美国______成功登上月球。
zh-word.ez: "宇航员"是坐飞船去太空的人。登上月球的是人——一九六九年，美国宇航员第一次登上了月球。

y.B: 声音 is a sound; a sound cannot step onto the moon.
y.C: 植物 are plants; plants did not fly to the moon, and the astronauts found none there.
y.D: 荒凉 describes a bare, lonely place; it cannot be the one who lands.

yz.B: "声音"是听到的，不会登上月球。
yz.C: 植物不会坐飞船；宇航员在月球上也没看到植物。
yz.D: "荒凉"是说地方冷冷清清，不能当登上月球的人。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：1969年，美国宇航员成功登上月球。他们发现月球是一个______的世界。
zh-word.e: 荒凉 means bare and lifeless. With no water, no plants or animals and no sound at all, the moon is 一个荒凉的世界.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第十二课《探月》 星期三，练习4（printed p.77）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 1969年，美国宇航员成功登上月球。他们发现月球是一个______的世界。
zh-word.ez: "荒凉"是什么都没有、冷冷清清。月球上没有水，没有动物和植物，听不到一点儿声音，是一个荒凉的世界。

y.A: 宇航员 are only visitors who came and went; the moon is not a world of astronauts.
y.B: 声音: the astronauts could not hear a single sound on the moon, so it is no world of sound.
y.C: 植物: there are no plants on the moon at all, so it is no world of plants.

yz.A: 宇航员只是去月球看看的人，月球不是"宇航员的世界"。
yz.B: 月球上听不到一点儿声音，不是"声音的世界"。
yz.C: 月球上没有植物，不是"植物的世界"。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：他们发现月球是一个荒凉的世界，没有水、______和动物。
zh-word.e: 植物 are plants. The list is of things the moon does not have: 没有水，没有动物和植物 — no water, no animals and no plants.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第十二课《探月》 星期三，练习4（printed p.77）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 他们发现月球是一个荒凉的世界，没有水、______和动物。
zh-word.ez: "植物"是花草树木。月球上没有的东西：没有水，没有动物和植物。

y.A: 宇航员: the astronauts were standing on the moon when they looked, so they cannot be one of the things it lacked.
y.B: 明白 means to understand; it is not a thing, so it cannot stand in a list beside 水 and 动物.
y.D: 荒凉 describes the place; it cannot stand in a list of things between 水 and 动物.

yz.A: 宇航员就站在月球上，不能说月球上没有宇航员。
yz.B: "明白"是懂了的意思，不是东西，不能和水、动物排在一起。
yz.D: "荒凉"是说地方的样子，不能和水、动物排在一起。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：他们发现月球是一个荒凉的世界，没有水、植物和动物，听不到一点儿______。
zh-word.e: 声音 is sound, the thing you hear — and 听 means to listen. On the moon 听不到一点儿声音: not a single sound.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第十二课《探月》 星期三，练习4（printed p.77）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 他们发现月球是一个荒凉的世界，没有水、植物和动物，听不到一点儿______。
zh-word.ez: "声音"是耳朵听到的。"听不到一点儿声音"：月球上一点儿声音也没有。

y.A: 宇航员 are people you see, not something you hear.
y.C: 植物 are seen, not heard — and the sentence has already said there are none.
y.D: 荒凉 is how a place looks; you cannot hear it.

yz.A: "宇航员"是看得见的人，不是用耳朵听的。
yz.C: 植物是看的，不是听的，前面也已经说没有植物了。
yz.D: "荒凉"是地方的样子，听不到。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：方方：那儿有植物或者小动物吗？云云：没有。月球是一个______的世界。
zh-word.e: 荒凉 means empty and lifeless — no plants, no animals. That is just what 云云 has said: 月球是一个荒凉的世界.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第十二课《探月》 星期四，练习1（printed p.77）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 方方：那儿有植物或者小动物吗？云云：没有。月球是一个______的世界。
zh-word.ez: "荒凉"是冷冷清清、什么也没有。没有植物，也没有小动物，所以说月球是一个荒凉的世界。

y.A: 实现 is a verb for a dream coming true; it cannot describe what a world is like.
y.B: 飞船 is the spaceship that goes there; the moon is not a world of spaceships.
y.D: 梦想 is a dream; going to the moon may be a dream, but 一个梦想的世界 does not say what the moon is like.

yz.A: "实现"是让梦想成真，不能用来说世界是什么样。
yz.B: "飞船"是坐着去太空的，月球不是"飞船的世界"。
yz.D: "梦想"是心里想做的事，说不出月球是什么样子。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：云云：好呀！那我们要努力学习才能______去月球的梦想。
zh-word.e: 实现 means to make a dream come true. 实现……的梦想 is the pair the lesson teaches: 人类实现了登月的梦想.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第十二课《探月》 星期四，练习1（printed p.77）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 云云：好呀！那我们要努力学习才能______去月球的梦想。
zh-word.ez: "实现"是让梦想变成真的。"实现……的梦想"课文里就有：人类实现了登月的梦想。

y.B: 飞船 is a thing, a spaceship; after 才能 the sentence needs an action.
y.C: 荒凉 describes a place; studying hard cannot make you 荒凉.
y.D: 梦想 is already at the end of the sentence; 梦想去月球的梦想 says dream twice.

yz.B: "飞船"是东西，"才能"后面要跟一个动作。
yz.C: "荒凉"是地方的样子，努力学习不是为了"荒凉"。
yz.D: 句子最后已经有"梦想"了，"梦想去月球的梦想"重复了。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：云云：好呀！那我们要努力学习才能实现去月球的______。
zh-word.e: 梦想 is a dream, something you hope to do one day. A dream is what 实现 makes come true: 实现去月球的梦想.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第十二课《探月》 星期四，练习1（printed p.77）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 云云：好呀！那我们要努力学习才能实现去月球的______。
zh-word.ez: "梦想"是心里很想做到的事。"实现"的就是梦想：实现去月球的梦想。

y.A: 实现 is already in the sentence, just before; the gap needs the thing that comes true.
y.B: 飞船: you can ride a spaceship to the moon, but you cannot make a spaceship come true.
y.C: 荒凉 describes the moon itself; 实现荒凉 does not make sense.

yz.A: "实现"前面已经有了，空里要填的是实现什么。
yz.B: 飞船可以坐，不能"实现"飞船。
yz.C: "荒凉"说的是月球的样子，"实现荒凉"说不通。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：方方：好！但是我们要怎么去呢？云云：我们可以坐______去月球呀！
zh-word.e: 飞船 is a spaceship, and 坐 goes with something you ride in: 坐飞船去月球, the way the astronauts went in the 阿波罗号.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第十二课《探月》 星期四，练习1（printed p.77）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 方方：好！但是我们要怎么去呢？云云：我们可以坐______去月球呀！
zh-word.ez: "飞船"是去太空坐的。"坐"后面要跟交通工具：坐飞船去月球，就像宇航员坐"阿波罗号"飞船。

y.A: 实现 is an action, not something you can sit in.
y.C: 荒凉 describes a place; you cannot ride in it.
y.D: 梦想 is a dream; you can have one, but you cannot ride it to the moon.

yz.A: "实现"是动作，不能坐。
yz.C: "荒凉"是地方的样子，不能坐着去。
yz.D: 梦想可以有，却不能坐着它去月球。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：方方：妈妈，我们今天学了关于人类______的事。
zh-word.e: 探月 is exploring the moon — the title of this lesson. What 方方 learned today is about people exploring the moon.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第十二课《探月》 星期五，练习3（printed p.80）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 方方：妈妈，我们今天学了关于人类______的事。
zh-word.ez: "探月"是探索月球，就是这一课的题目。今天学的是人类探月的事。

y.A: 工程 is a big project; 人类工程的事 does not say what they learned — the 工程 comes later, in 探月工程.
y.B: 美国 is the answer to Mom's next question; 人类美国 is not a phrase.
y.D: 月亮 is the moon itself; what people did there is 探月, not 人类月亮.

yz.A: "工程"是很大的项目，"人类工程的事"说不清学了什么；后面才说到"探月工程"。
yz.B: "美国"是后面回答妈妈的话，"人类美国"不成词。
yz.D: "月亮"是月球本身，没有"人类月亮"的说法；人类做的事是探月。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：妈妈：第一次成功登月的宇航员是哪个国家的啊？方方：是______的！
zh-word.e: 美国 is the United States. Mom asks which country, so the answer is a country — the 课文 says 美国宇航员第一次登上了月球.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第十二课《探月》 星期五，练习3（printed p.80）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 妈妈：第一次成功登月的宇航员是哪个国家的啊？方方：是______的！
zh-word.ez: "美国"是一个国家。妈妈问哪个国家，回答要说国家的名字——课文说：美国宇航员第一次登上了月球。

y.A: 工程 is a project, not a country.
y.C: 探月 is what the astronauts did, not where they came from.
y.D: 月亮 is where they landed, not their country.

yz.A: "工程"是项目，不是国家。
yz.C: "探月"是宇航员做的事，不是国家。
yz.D: "月亮"是他们去的地方，不是他们的国家。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：方方：但是妈妈，我有个问题，为什么中国的探月______叫“嫦娥”呢？
zh-word.e: 工程 is a big project. China's moon project in the 课文 is the 嫦娥探月工程, so the word after 探月 is 工程.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第十二课《探月》 星期五，练习3（printed p.80）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 方方：但是妈妈，我有个问题，为什么中国的探月______叫“嫦娥”呢？
zh-word.ez: "工程"是很大的项目。课文里中国的是"嫦娥探月工程"，所以"探月"后面是"工程"。

y.B: 美国 is a country, and the moon program here is China's, not America's.
y.C: 探月 is already right before the gap; 探月探月 says it twice.
y.D: 探月月亮 is not a word; what is named 嫦娥 is the project.

yz.B: "美国"是国家，这里说的是中国的探月工程。
yz.C: "探月"前面已经有了，"探月探月"重复了。
yz.D: 没有"探月月亮"这个说法，叫"嫦娥"的是探月工程。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：妈妈：这是因为在中国神话中嫦娥是一位仙女，她就住在______上。
zh-word.e: 月亮 is the moon. In the Chinese legend Chang'e is a fairy who lives on the moon, which is why the moon program carries her name.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第十二课《探月》 星期五，练习3（printed p.80）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 妈妈：这是因为在中国神话中嫦娥是一位仙女，她就住在______上。
zh-word.ez: "月亮"就是月球。中国神话里，嫦娥是一位仙女，住在月亮上，所以探月工程叫"嫦娥"。

y.A: 工程 is a project; a fairy cannot live on a project.
y.B: 美国 is a country on Earth; the legend puts Chang'e up in the sky.
y.C: 探月 is something people do, exploring the moon; nobody can live on it.

yz.A: "工程"是项目，仙女不能住在工程上。
yz.B: "美国"是地球上的国家，神话里嫦娥住在天上。
yz.C: "探月"是一件事，不能住在上面。

L01.source: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第一课《寒假见闻》

blocks.title: 找出不同类的词
blocks.title_en: Find the odd words out

blocks.title: 选择恰当的词语完成对话
blocks.title_en: Choose the correct words to complete the dialogue

blocks.title: 读一读，根据图中的情境和词语提示完成对话
blocks.title_en: Read and use the picture clue and the given words to complete the dialogue

exercises.title: 描一描，写一写
exercises.title_en: Trace and write

note.zh: 看旁边的词想字，用笔写出来。点"写好了"以后，标准写法会显示在你写的字下面，对照一下；笔顺按规则判。
note.en: The word beside the box tells you the character; write it with the Pencil. When you tap Done, the standard form appears beneath what you wrote so you can compare; stroke order is judged by rule.

explanation.zh: 见闻：wén。
explanation.en: 见闻 — wén, what one sees and hears.

explanation.zh: 长城：chéng。
explanation.en: 长城 — chéng, the Great Wall.

explanation.zh: 亲切：qiè。
explanation.en: 亲切 — qiè, warm and familiar.

explanation.zh: 逛街：guàng。
explanation.en: 逛街 — guàng, stroll along the streets.

explanation.zh: 四合院：hé。
explanation.en: 四合院 — hé, a courtyard house.

explanation.zh: 暖和：nuǎn。
explanation.en: 暖和 — nuǎn, warm.

explanation.zh: 弯曲：qū。
explanation.en: 弯曲 — qū, winding.

explanation.zh: 北京既古老，又现代：jì。
explanation.en: 北京既古老，又现代 — jì: Beijing is both old and modern.

exercises.title: 半包围结构、左右结构、上下结构，还是独体字？
exercises.title_en: Half-enclosed, left–right, top–bottom, or a single-body character?

explanation.zh: 门从上面和两边包住耳：半包围结构。
explanation.en: 门 wraps 耳 from the top and both sides: half-enclosed.

explanation.zh: 土在左、成在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 土 on the left, 成 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 七在左、刀在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 七 on the left, 刀 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 辶从左边和下面包住狂：半包围结构。
explanation.en: 辶 wraps 狂 along the left and the bottom: half-enclosed.

explanation.zh: 人在上，一和口在下：上下结构。
explanation.en: 人 on top, 一 and 口 below: top–bottom.

explanation.zh: 日在左、爰在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 日 on the left, 爰 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 曲不能拆成两部分：独体字。
explanation.en: 曲 cannot be split into parts: a single-body character.

explanation.zh: 左边一半，右边是旡：左右结构。
explanation.en: One half on the left, 旡 on the right: left–right.

exercises.title: 照例子，写一写
exercises.title_en: Follow the example and write

note.zh: 例：口＋那 → 哪。看着两个部件，用笔把字写出来。点"写好了"以后，标准写法会显示在你写的字下面，对照一下；笔顺按规则判。
note.en: Example: 口 + 那 → 哪. Look at the two parts and write the character with the Pencil. When you tap Done, the standard form appears beneath what you wrote so you can compare; stroke order is judged by rule.

explanation.zh: 亻在左，昔在右：借。
explanation.en: 亻 on the left, 昔 on the right: 借.

explanation.zh: 艹在上，监在下：蓝。
explanation.en: 艹 on top, 监 below: 蓝.

explanation.zh: 辶在左边和下面，狂在里面：逛。
explanation.en: 辶 along the left and the bottom, 狂 inside: 逛.

explanation.zh: 日在左，爰在右：暖。
explanation.en: 日 on the left, 爰 on the right: 暖.

explanation.zh: 王字旁在左（最后一笔写成提），见在右：现。
explanation.en: 王 on the left, its last stroke turned into a rising tick, and 见 on the right: 现.

explanation.zh: 土字旁在左（最后一笔写成提），成在右：城。
explanation.en: 土 on the left, its last stroke turned into a rising tick, and 成 on the right: 城.

exercises.title: 连一连，组词语
exercises.title_en: Match to form words

note.zh: 先点上面的字，再点下面能和它组成词的字。课本已连好一组：寒—假。
note.en: Tap a character on the top row, then the one below that makes a word with it. The book has drawn one line already: 寒—假.

explanation.zh: 介—绍：介绍。
explanation.en: 介 + 绍 = 介绍, introduce.

explanation.zh: 寒—假：寒假——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: 寒 + 假 = 寒假, winter vacation — the book's own example.

explanation.zh: 非—常：非常。
explanation.en: 非 + 常 = 非常, very.

explanation.zh: 印—象：印象。
explanation.en: 印 + 象 = 印象, impression.

explanation.zh: 现—金：现金。"现象"也是一个词，可那样"印"就没有字可连了。
explanation.en: 现 + 金 = 现金, cash. 现象 is a word too, but then 印 would have nothing left to join.

note.zh: 每句后面有两个词，选那个放进（　）里读得通的。
note.en: Each sentence offers two words; choose the one that makes the sentence right.

explanation.zh: 这句是问话（句末是"啊？"），问去什么地方玩，要用问地方的"哪里"。"那里"是"那个地方"，不是问话的词。
explanation.en: The sentence is a question (it ends in 啊？) asking where to go, so it needs the question word 哪里, where. 那里 means 'that place'; it does not ask a question.

items.text: （2）我和爸爸妈妈去北京（　）爷爷和奶奶。

explanation.zh: 去北京是为了去看爷爷奶奶，"看望"就是去看人；课文说：回北京看望了爷爷奶奶。"介绍"是让人认识，不是去北京做的事。
explanation.en: They go to Beijing to see the grandparents, and 看望 is to visit someone; the text says 回北京看望了爷爷奶奶. 介绍 means to introduce, which is not why they went.

explanation.zh: 交通说的是出门坐车、走路，好不好走要说"方便"；课文说：交通非常方便。"美丽"说的是好看。
explanation.en: 交通 is getting around, and how easy that is gets 方便, convenient; the text says 交通非常方便. 美丽 means beautiful, a word for how things look.

explanation.zh: 洒在大地上、让人觉得温暖的，是太阳的光——阳光。月亮不会让大地暖和。
explanation.en: What spreads over the ground and feels warm is sunshine, 阳光. The moon does not warm the ground.

exercises.title: 根据图片选择正确的句子
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct sentences for the pictures

note.zh: 图在练习册第5页。每组两句，一句对、一句错。
note.en: The pictures are on workbook p. 5. Each pair has one true sentence and one false.

items.text: 今年寒假我们看望爷爷奶奶。

explanation.zh: 图上小女孩张开手跑向爷爷奶奶：他们去看望爷爷奶奶了。
explanation.en: In the picture the girl runs with open arms to her grandparents: they are visiting them.

items.text: 今年寒假我在家做作业。

explanation.zh: 图上没有书桌，也没有作业，是小女孩在见爷爷奶奶。
explanation.en: There is no desk and no homework in the picture; the girl is greeting her grandparents.

items.text: 我和爸爸很喜欢到处走走。

explanation.zh: 图上爸爸拉着孩子的手在走路。
explanation.en: In the picture the father holds the child's hand and they are walking.

items.text: 我和爸爸很喜欢在家里看电视。

explanation.zh: 图上没有电视，爸爸和孩子是在走路。
explanation.en: There is no television in the picture; father and child are out walking.

items.text: 人们去哪儿都可以用手机付款。

explanation.zh: 图上的人拿手机对着柜台上的二维码付款，就像课文说的：去哪儿都可以用手机付款。
explanation.en: In the picture someone holds a phone to the code on the counter to pay, just as the text says: 去哪儿都可以用手机付款.

items.text: 人们去哪儿都用现金付款。

explanation.zh: 图上的人用的是手机，不是现金。
explanation.en: The person in the picture pays with a phone, not with cash.

exercises.title: 将指定词语填写在句子的合适位置
exercises.title_en: Put the given words in the appropriate positions in the sentences

note.zh: 例：她喜欢你。（不）→ 她不喜欢你。把括号里的词放进句子里，再把整句写下来。图在练习册第6–7页。
note.en: Example: 她喜欢你。 (不) → 她不喜欢你。 Put the word in brackets into the sentence and write the whole sentence out. The pictures are on workbook pp. 6–7.

items.prompt_en: (1) 她喜欢唱歌，喜欢跳舞。 (既……又……) — the whole sentence
(2) 人们出行方便。 (非常) — the whole sentence
(3) 我喜欢吃的水果是西瓜。 (最) — the whole sentence

items.prompt: （4）我非常喜欢这个书包，那是爸爸送给我的。（因为）
items.prompt_en: (4) 我非常喜欢这个书包，那是爸爸送给我的。 (因为) — the whole sentence

exercises.title: 选择正确的词语完成句子
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct words to complete the sentences

note.zh: 例：学校里有学生。（有　是）每句后面有两个词，选一个放进（　）里。
note.en: Example: 学校里有学生。 (有 / 是) Each sentence offers two words; choose the one for the blank.

explanation.zh: "寒假来了"是放寒假的时候到了，所以想去爷爷家玩儿。北京是一个地方，不会"来了"。
explanation.en: 寒假来了 means the winter vacation has come, so there is time to visit Grandpa. 北京 is a city, and a city does not come.

explanation.zh: "成为一名科学家"是长大后变成科学家，课本"用一用"里就有这一句。"作为"是"以……的身份"，后面还要说做什么，不能这样用。
explanation.en: 成为一名科学家 is to become a scientist, and the textbook's 用一用 list has it word for word. 作为 means as, in the role of, and needs more after it.

explanation.zh: 付款要用钱，"现金"就是钱；杯子不能用来付款。
explanation.en: To pay you need money, and 现金 is cash. A cup (杯子) cannot pay for anything.

explanation.zh: 放学回到家，对爸爸说"我放学回来了"。"上去"是往高处去，放在这里不通。
explanation.en: Home from school, you tell Dad 我放学回来了, I am back. 上去 means going up somewhere higher, which does not fit.

exercises.title: 照例子，写句子
exercises.title_en: Follow the example to write the sentences

note.zh: 例：我 是 小学生。→ 妈妈 是 医生。中间的词不变，换掉别的词，写一个新句子。
note.en: Example: 我 是 小学生。 → 妈妈 是 医生。 Keep the word in the middle, change the others, and write a new sentence.

items.prompt_en: (1) 我喜欢北京。 → a new sentence with 喜欢
(2) 交通非常方便。 → a new sentence with 非常
(3) 我想成为一名老师。 → a new sentence with 成为

exercises.title: 根据课文判断正误
exercises.title_en: Decide whether the statements are true or false according to the text

items.text: 今年暑假，我们全家回北京看望了爷爷奶奶。

explanation.zh: 课文第一句是"今年寒假"，不是暑假。
explanation.en: The text opens with 今年寒假 — this winter vacation, not the summer one (暑假).

items.text: 爷爷奶奶带我去了天安门、故宫和长城。

explanation.zh: 课文说：爷爷奶奶带着我们去了好多地方，天安门、故宫、长城……
explanation.en: The text says the grandparents took them to many places: 天安门、故宫、长城……

explanation.zh: 课文说的正相反：交通非常方便。
explanation.en: The text says the opposite: 交通非常方便, getting around is very convenient.

items.text: 在北京我借到了想看的动画片。

explanation.zh: 课文说"我就借到了想看的书"，借到的是书，不是动画片。
explanation.en: The text says 我就借到了想看的书 — what he borrowed was a book, not a cartoon.

exercises.title: 根据句子选择正确的图片
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct pictures for the sentences

note.zh: 四张图在练习册第9页，标着A、B、C、D。先点句子，再点它说的那张图。
note.en: The four pictures are on workbook p. 9, lettered A to D. Tap a sentence, then the picture it describes.

left: 吃饭的时候，我们全家计划去旅行。
我们想先坐飞机去北京。
最后一起去吃北京的冰糖葫芦。

items.left: 吃饭的时候，我们全家计划去旅行。

explanation.zh: 一家人围着桌子吃饭——图C。
explanation.en: A family eating around a table — picture C.

items.left: 我们想先坐飞机去北京。

explanation.zh: 机场和飞机——图B。
explanation.en: An airport and planes — picture B.

explanation.zh: 图A是一座古代的城楼，样子更像天安门；不过另外三句已经各有各的图（C吃饭、B飞机、D冰糖葫芦），剩下的就是图A。
explanation.en: Picture A is an old gate tower, and it looks more like 天安门 than a building inside the Forbidden City; but the other three sentences already have their pictures (C the meal, B the plane, D the 冰糖葫芦), so A is the one left.

items.left: 最后一起去吃北京的冰糖葫芦。

explanation.zh: 一串串红红的冰糖葫芦——图D。
explanation.en: Skewers of red candied haws, 冰糖葫芦 — picture D.

exercises.title: 根据课文，给正确的答案涂色
exercises.title_en: Color the correct answers according to the text

note.zh: 每个问题下面有两个回答，一个对、一个错。根据课文判断。
note.en: Each question has two answers, one true and one false. Decide by the text.

items.text: （1）他们寒假去哪里了？A．他们去了北京。

explanation.zh: 课文第一句：今年寒假，我们全家回北京看望了爷爷奶奶。他们去的是北京。
explanation.en: The text's first line: 今年寒假，我们全家回北京看望了爷爷奶奶 — they went to Beijing.

items.text: （1）他们寒假去哪里了？B．他们去了广州。

explanation.zh: 课文里去的是北京，没有说广州。
explanation.en: The text is about Beijing; Guangzhou (广州) is never mentioned.

items.text: （2）他们去看望谁？A．他们去看望姑姑。

explanation.zh: 课文说看望的是爷爷奶奶，不是姑姑。
explanation.en: The text says they visited Grandpa and Grandma, not an aunt (姑姑).

items.text: （2）他们去看望谁？B．他们去看望爷爷奶奶。

explanation.zh: 课文说：回北京看望了爷爷奶奶。
explanation.en: The text says so: 回北京看望了爷爷奶奶.

items.text: （3）到达北京后，他们去故宫了吗？A．他们去故宫了。

explanation.zh: 课文说：爷爷奶奶带着我们去了好多地方，天安门、故宫、长城……他们去了故宫。
explanation.en: The text lists 故宫 among the places the grandparents took them: 天安门、故宫、长城……

items.text: （3）到达北京后，他们去故宫了吗？B．他们没去故宫。

explanation.zh: 故宫就在爷爷奶奶带他们去的地方里，说没去是错的。
explanation.en: 故宫 is one of the places the grandparents took them, so saying they did not go is false.

items.text: （4）人们大都用什么付款？A．去哪儿都可以用手机付款。

explanation.zh: 课文说：现在人们出门不用带现金，去哪儿都可以用手机付款。
explanation.en: The text says: 现在人们出门不用带现金，去哪儿都可以用手机付款 — people can pay by phone anywhere.

items.text: （4）人们大都用什么付款？B．他们用现金付款。

explanation.zh: 课文说出门不用带现金，大家用手机付款，不是用现金。
explanation.en: The text says people no longer need to carry cash; they pay by phone, not with cash.

exercises.title: 根据你旅游过的一个地方，填写表格
exercises.title_en: Fill in the form to describe a place that you visited

note.zh: 想一个你去旅游过的地方，把表格的六行填好。
note.en: Think of a place you have visited, and fill in the six rows of the form.

exercises.title: 把课文读给爸爸妈妈听，请他们评评分
exercises.title_en: Read the text aloud to your parents and ask them to grade

question.zh: 把《寒假见闻》读给爸爸妈妈听。读完请他们评评分：读得流利吗？有没有读错的字？
question.en: Read 寒假见闻 aloud to your parents. Then ask them to grade it: was it fluent, and were any characters misread?

note.zh: 课文在课本第2–3页，看着书读。读的时候会录下来；读完请爸爸妈妈评个分，再点一下"家长已听"。
note.en: The text is on textbook pp. 2–3; read it from the book. Your reading is recorded; afterwards have your parents give it a grade and tap Listened.

exercises.title: 听录音判断对错
exercises.title_en: Listen and check

note.zh: 请爸爸妈妈读练习册第82页第1课的听力文本（或放录音）。每听一句，看练习册第12–13页那一题的两张图：图和句子说的一样就选"对"，不一样就选"错"。
note.en: Ask a parent to read the Lesson 1 listening script on workbook p. 82 (or play the recording). After each sentence, look at that question's two pictures on workbook pp. 12–13: mark a picture true if it shows what the sentence says, false if it does not.

explanation.zh: 录音第（1）句：今天早上我七点就起床了。图A的男孩在床上坐起来伸懒腰，旁边有闹钟——起床了，对。
explanation.en: Sentence (1): 今天早上我七点就起床了 — I got up at seven. Picture A shows the boy sitting up and stretching beside an alarm clock: getting up. True.

explanation.zh: 图B的男孩还躺着睡觉，没有起床，错。
explanation.en: In picture B the boy is still asleep, not getting up. False.

explanation.zh: 录音第（2）句：然后我和爸爸妈妈一起吃早饭。图A是两个人在刷牙，不是吃饭，错。
explanation.en: Sentence (2): 然后我和爸爸妈妈一起吃早饭 — then I had breakfast with Mom and Dad. Picture A shows two people brushing their teeth, not eating. False.

explanation.zh: 图B是爸爸、妈妈和孩子一起在桌边吃饭，对。
explanation.en: Picture B shows father, mother and child eating together at the table. True.

explanation.zh: 录音第（3）句：吃完饭后，爸爸开车带我们出去玩儿。图A是男孩在扫地，不是开车出去，错。
explanation.en: Sentence (3): 吃完饭后，爸爸开车带我们出去玩儿 — after the meal Dad drove us out to have fun. Picture A shows the boy sweeping the floor. False.

explanation.zh: 图B是一辆汽车开在路上——爸爸开车带我们出去，对。
explanation.en: Picture B shows a car on the road — Dad driving them out. True.

explanation.zh: 录音第（4）句：我们玩得非常开心。图A的爸爸和孩子拿着气球跑，笑得很开心，对。
explanation.en: Sentence (4): 我们玩得非常开心 — we had a great time. In picture A father and son run along with a balloon, laughing. True.

explanation.zh: 图B的男孩在哭，不开心，错。
explanation.en: The boy in picture B is crying — not happy. False.

exercises.title: 读一读，判断句子的正误
exercises.title_en: Read the sentences and decide whether the statements below are true or false

note.zh: 每题先读第一句，再判断☆后面的句子对不对。例：我会跳舞，但是跳得不怎么样。☆我跳舞跳得很好。（×）
note.en: Read the first sentence of each, then decide whether the starred sentence is true. Example: 我会跳舞，但是跳得不怎么样。 ☆我跳舞跳得很好。 (false)

items.text: 我觉得奶奶特别亲切。☆我觉得奶奶非常好。

explanation.zh: "特别"就是"非常"；觉得奶奶特别亲切，就是觉得奶奶非常好，对。
explanation.en: 特别 means the same as 非常, very. Finding Grandma especially warm and dear is thinking she is very nice. True.

items.text: 现在去哪儿都不用现金付款。☆我们用现金付款买东西。

explanation.zh: 上面说不用现金付款，☆后面说用现金付款，正好相反，错。
explanation.en: The first sentence says you need no cash to pay anywhere; the starred one says we pay with cash — the opposite. False.

items.text: 长大后，我想成为一名教师。☆我是一名教师。

explanation.zh: "想成为"是长大后的愿望，现在还不是教师，错。
explanation.en: 想成为 is a wish for when I grow up; I am not a teacher yet. False.

items.text: 我经常去图书馆学习。☆我很少去图书馆学习。

explanation.zh: "经常"是常常去，"很少"是不常去，意思相反，错。
explanation.en: 经常 means often and 很少 means seldom — opposite meanings. False.

exercises.title: 写一写你寒假中一天的活动（四十字以上）
exercises.title_en: Write about your daily activities during the winter vacation with more than 40 characters

note.zh: 提示：（1）你几点起床？（2）上午和谁在一起？做了什么？（3）中午是谁做的午饭？（4）午饭你吃了什么？最喜欢吃什么？（5）下午又有什么有趣的活动？（6）你一天的心情怎么样？
note.en: Prompts: (1) What time did you get up? (2) Who were you with in the morning, and what did you do? (3) Who made lunch? (4) What did you eat for lunch, and what did you like best? (5) What fun things did you do in the afternoon? (6) How did you feel that day?

items.text: 有机会我要去故宫逛逛。

explanation.zh: "逛逛"把"逛"说两遍，意思是随便走走、看一看——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: 逛逛 says the verb twice, which makes it a relaxed 'have a stroll round' — the book's own example.

explanation.zh: 句子停在一个"逛"上，听起来没说完；要说"逛逛"。
explanation.en: Stopping on a single 逛 sounds unfinished; the sentence wants 逛逛.

items.text: 奶奶对爸爸说：“常回家看看。”

explanation.zh: "看看"：回家来看一看，说得亲切自然。
explanation.en: 看看 — come home and look in on us — is the warm, natural way to say it.

items.text: 奶奶对爸爸说：“常回家看。”

explanation.zh: 一个"看"放在句尾，话像没说完；要说"看看"。
explanation.en: A single 看 at the end leaves the sentence hanging; it wants 看看.

items.text: 哥哥，我借你的铅笔用，好吗？

explanation.zh: 借来用一下，要说"用用"；只说一个"用"，听起来不自然。
explanation.en: Borrowing something for a moment is 用用, use it for a bit; a single 用 sounds abrupt.

items.text: 哥哥，我借你的铅笔用用，好吗？

explanation.zh: "用用"是用一下，说得轻、有礼貌。
explanation.en: 用用 means use it for a little while — light and polite.

items.text: 放假我也要去长城看看。

explanation.zh: "看看"是去看一看，和"去故宫逛逛"一样。
explanation.en: 看看 is go and have a look, just like 去故宫逛逛.

explanation.zh: 句尾只有一个"看"，话没说完；要说"看看"。
explanation.en: Ending on a single 看 leaves it unfinished; the sentence wants 看看.

items.text: 早上我会和姐姐在花园走。

explanation.zh: 在花园里随便走一走，要说"走走"；一个"走"放在句尾不自然。
explanation.en: A stroll round the garden is 走走; a single 走 at the end does not sound right.

explanation.zh: "走走"是散散步、随便走一走。
explanation.en: 走走 means take a little walk, a stroll.

note.zh: 请爸爸妈妈先读一读练习册第82页附录"听力文本"里第2课的句子（或放录音），每读一句，你选一个答案。练习册上的例子：问：爷爷居住在哪里？答：A．北京市。
note.en: Ask a parent to read the Lesson 2 sentences in the 附录 listening scripts on workbook p. 82 (or play the recording), one at a time, and choose an answer after each. The book's example: 爷爷居住在哪里? Answer: A, 北京市.

explanation.zh: 听到的句子说，墙上挂着一张世界地图。
explanation.en: The sentence you heard says a world map hangs on the wall.

explanation.zh: 听到的句子说哥哥在国外留学："留学"就是到外国去上学。
explanation.en: The sentence you heard says the brother 在国外留学 — 留学 is going to another country to study.

explanation.zh: 听到的句子说故宫是中国明朝和清朝的皇宫，课文第一段也是这么说的。
explanation.en: The sentence you heard says it was the palace of the Ming and the Qing, just as the text's first paragraph says.

explanation.zh: 听到的句子说故宫又叫紫禁城，课文里也有：又叫紫禁城。长城是另一个地方。
explanation.en: The sentence you heard says the palace is also called 紫禁城, as the text does; 长城 is the Great Wall, somewhere else.

exercises.title: 看图，判断正误
exercises.title_en: Look and check

note.zh: 图在练习册第12页。每组两句，一句对、一句错。课本给的例子：爸爸在开车。（对）
note.en: The pictures are on workbook p. 12. Each pair has one right sentence and one wrong. The book's example: 爸爸在开车 is the right one.

explanation.zh: 图上是爸爸在开车——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: The picture shows the father driving — the book's own example.

explanation.zh: 开车的是爸爸，不是妈妈——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: The driver is the father, not the mother — the book's own example.

explanation.zh: 图上的女士站在讲桌后面，一手拿书，一手拿教鞭：是老师。
explanation.en: The woman stands behind a desk with a book in one hand and a pointer in the other: a teacher.

explanation.zh: 她拿着书和教鞭站在讲桌后面，是在上课，不是在看病。
explanation.en: With a book and a pointer behind a desk she is teaching, not treating patients.

explanation.zh: 图上是几朵红花，花是用眼睛看的：看看美丽的花。
explanation.en: The picture shows red flowers, and flowers are for looking at: 看看美丽的花.

explanation.zh: 图上没有歌，只有花；歌是听的，花是看的。
explanation.en: There is no song in the picture, only flowers; songs are heard, flowers are seen.

exercises.title_en: Match

note.en: On the left, the questions; on the right, the answers. Tap a question, then the answer that goes with it.

right: 我去北京看望爷爷奶奶了。
好玩儿！有机会你也去逛逛吧。

explanation.zh: 问去哪儿，答一个地方：我去北京看望爷爷奶奶了。
explanation.en: Asked where, the answer names a place: 我去北京看望爷爷奶奶了.

explanation.zh: 看到长城，就说：真好看！我也要去看看。
explanation.en: Shown the Great Wall, you say how lovely it is and that you want to go and see it too.

explanation.zh: 问"和谁"，答一个人：和妈妈。
explanation.en: Asked 'with whom', the answer is a person: 和妈妈.

explanation.zh: 问好不好玩儿，答：好玩儿！有机会你也去逛逛吧。
explanation.en: Asked whether it is fun, the answer begins 好玩儿 — yes, it is.

exercises.title: 左右结构、半包围结构，还是独体字？
exercises.title_en: Left–right, half-enclosed, or a single-body character?

explanation.zh: 臣在左、页在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 臣 on the left, 页 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 久不能拆成两部分：独体字。
explanation.en: 久 cannot be split into parts: a single-body character.

explanation.zh: 立在左、占在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 立 on the left, 占 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 木在左、乔在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 木 on the left, 乔 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 广从上面和左面包住郎：半包围结构。
explanation.en: 广 wraps 郎 from the top and the left: half-enclosed.

explanation.zh: 目在左、艮在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 目 on the left, 艮 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 丩在左、攵在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 丩 on the left, 攵 on the right: left–right.

note.en: The pictures are in the workbook: (1) and (2) on p. 19, (3) and (4) on p. 20. Look at each one and choose the word that names it.

explanation.zh: 图上是一座有很多桥洞的长石桥，就是课文里的十七孔桥。花园里有花，图上没有。
explanation.en: The picture is a long stone bridge with many arches, the Seventeen-Arch Bridge of the lesson: 石桥. A garden (花园) has flowers, and there are none.

explanation.zh: 图上是一头长着大鬃毛的狮子。狐狸个子小，没有鬃毛。
explanation.en: The picture is a lion with a big mane: 狮子. A fox (狐狸) is small and has no mane.

explanation.zh: 图上的男孩站着，没有坐下：站立。
explanation.en: The boy in the picture is standing up, not sitting down: 站立.

explanation.zh: 图上是一丛绿色的草，没有花：绿草。

exercises.title: 照例子，用"终于"完成句子
exercises.title_en: Follow the example to complete the sentences with "zhōngyú"

items.prompt: 例：今年寒假，我终于来到了向往已久的颐和园。（1）＿＿，＿＿终于＿＿。
items.prompt_en: Example: 今年寒假，我终于来到了向往已久的颐和园。 (1) …，…终于…。

exercises.title: 连词成句
exercises.title_en: Write the words in the correct order to make sentences

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：我终于来到了颐和园。
explanation.en: In order: 我终于来到了颐和园 — I finally arrived at the Summer Palace.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：颐和园的景色十分美丽。
explanation.en: In order: 颐和园的景色十分美丽 — the Summer Palace's scenery is very beautiful.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：湖中心有个小岛。
explanation.en: In order: 湖中心有个小岛 — in the middle of the lake there is an island.

exercises.title: 请用中文写出你周末想要去的五个地方
exercises.title_en: List five places you want to visit on weekends in Chinese

note.zh: 例：体育活动中心。
note.en: Example: 体育活动中心.

exercises.title: 读一读
exercises.title_en: Read aloud

note.zh: 读出来，录下来就行，不打分。对照在批改的时候看。
note.en: Just read it aloud; it is recorded, not scored. The comparison is for the evaluation.

exercises.text:
中心 湖中心 广场中心 文化中心
十分美丽 十分生动 十分可爱 十分难忘
绿色 红色 白色 蓝色
小桥 孔桥 桥洞 一座桥

exercises.title: 给正确的词语涂上你喜欢的颜色
exercises.title_en: Color the correct words with your favorite color

note.zh: 每句给了两个词语，选出对的那个。练习册上，把它涂上你喜欢的颜色。
note.en: Each sentence offers two words; choose the right one. In the workbook, colour it in with your favourite colour.

explanation.zh: 找了很久，最后找到了，用“终于”。“非常”说的是很、特别，后面跟“好、喜欢”这样的词，不能说“非常找到”。
explanation.en: 终于 means 'at last': after a long search, the bag was found. 非常 means 'very' and goes before words like 好 or 喜欢; 非常找到 is not Chinese.

explanation.zh: 城市的中心是城市中间的地方，那里才能有高楼。“重点”是最要紧的部分，不是一个地方。
explanation.en: 中心 is the centre, a place in the city where tall buildings can stand. 重点 means 'the key point'; it is not a place.

explanation.zh: 说画儿画得像活的一样，用“生动”。课文说桥上的小石狮子“都很生动”。“难忘”说的是让人忘不了的事情，像课文最后的“让人十分难忘”。
explanation.en: 生动 means lifelike, vivid: the word for a painting or a carving. The lesson says the little stone lions 都很生动. 难忘, 'unforgettable', is said of something you lived through, as at the end of the lesson: 让人十分难忘.

explanation.zh: 课文说长廊上是“绿色的柱子，红色的栏杆”。洞口是山洞或桥洞的口，长廊两边没有。
explanation.en: The lesson describes the Long Corridor as 绿色的柱子，红色的栏杆: green pillars, red railings. A 洞口 is the mouth of a cave or a hole, and the corridor has none.

exercises.title_en: Choose the correct pictures for the sentences

note.en: The four pictures are on workbook p. 22, lettered A to D. Tap a sentence, then the picture it describes.

从湖边到湖中心的小岛，要走过十七孔桥。

explanation.zh: 来到颐和园——图D是挂着"颐和园"牌子的大门。
explanation.en: Arriving at the Summer Palace — picture D is the gate with the 颐和园 plaque.

items.left: 从湖边到湖中心的小岛，要走过十七孔桥。

explanation.zh: 十七孔桥——图C是有很多桥洞的长石桥。
explanation.en: The Seventeen-Arch Bridge — picture C is the long stone bridge with many arches.

items.left: 走在著名的长廊上，绿色的柱子，红色的栏杆，一眼望不到头。

explanation.zh: 长廊，绿柱子红栏杆——图B。
explanation.en: The long corridor with green pillars and red railings — picture B.

exercises.title: 读课文，回答问题
exercises.title_en: Read the text and answer the questions

items.prompt_en: (1) Where did the writer go this winter vacation?
(2) Going in by the east gate, what did the writer see?
(3) What is in the middle of the lake?

items.prompt: （4）十七孔桥两边的石柱上有什么？
items.prompt_en: (4) What is on the stone pillars at the two sides of the Seventeen-Arch Bridge?

exercises.title: 根据课文回答问题
exercises.title_en: Answer the questions according to the text

note.zh: 根据课文《颐和园》（课本第22–23页），每题选A或B。第（3）（4）题在练习册第25页。
note.en: Answer from the lesson text, 颐和园 (textbook pp. 22–23), by choosing A or B. Questions (3) and (4) are on workbook p. 25.

explanation.zh: 课文第一句：今年寒假，我终于来到了向往已久的颐和园。B说的是“我”是谁，没有回答去了哪里。
explanation.en: The lesson's first sentence: 今年寒假，我终于来到了向往已久的颐和园. B says who 'I' am, and does not answer where 'I' went.

options: 有昆明湖、十七孔桥和长廊。

explanation.zh: 课文里写到的是昆明湖、十七孔桥和长廊。天坛和故宫也在北京，可是不在颐和园里，课文也没有写。
explanation.en: The lesson walks past 昆明湖, 十七孔桥 and 长廊. The Temple of Heaven and the Palace Museum are in Beijing too, but not in the Summer Palace, and the lesson does not mention them.

items.text: （3）为什么那座长长的石桥叫“十七孔桥”？

explanation.zh: 课文说：这座桥有十七个桥洞，叫十七孔桥。“孔”就是洞。
explanation.en: The lesson says 这座桥有十七个桥洞，叫十七孔桥: it has seventeen arches. 孔 means a hole or an opening.

items.text: （4）在哪里可以看见颐和园的全部景色？

explanation.zh: 课文说：登上万寿山，颐和园的景色尽收眼底。走完长廊只是来到万寿山脚下，还看不到全部。
explanation.en: The lesson says 登上万寿山，颐和园的景色尽收眼底: from the top of Longevity Hill you see it all. At the end of the corridor you are only at the foot of the hill.

exercises.title: 选择相应的语句补全对话
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct expressions to complete the dialogue

note.zh: 对话里缺了四句，看练习册第25页的地图选。
note.en: Four lines are missing; use the map on workbook p. 25 to choose.

options: 你先向前走，第一个路口左转

items.before: 大卫：______，我想问一下，去学校怎么走？

explanation.zh: 开口问路先打招呼：您好，我想问一下……
explanation.en: You greet before you ask the way: 您好，我想问一下…

items.before: 老王：我看看啊！我们在这里……　大卫：对。　老王：我知道了。______

explanation.zh: 老王告诉他去学校的路：你先向前走，第一个路口左转。地图上红线就是这么走的。
explanation.en: Lao Wang gives the way to the school: go straight first, then turn left at the first crossing — the red line on the map.

items.before: 大卫：好的。我还想买点儿东西，______？

explanation.zh: 想买东西，就问商场怎么走。
explanation.en: He wants to buy something, so he asks the way to the mall: 请问商场怎么走？

items.before: 老王：一直向前走就可以了。

explanation.zh: 问完路要道谢：谢谢您。
explanation.en: After being shown the way, you thank the person: 谢谢您。

exercises.title: 听一听，根据问题判断句子正误
exercises.title_en: Listen and decide whether the sentences are true or false

note.zh: 请爸爸妈妈读一读练习册第82页第3课的听力文本（或放录音），听完再判断对错。
note.en: Ask a parent to read the Lesson 3 listening script on workbook p. 82 (or play the recording), then mark each sentence.

explanation.zh: 男生说：今天天气很好。
explanation.en: The boy says 今天天气很好 — the weather is good.

explanation.zh: 男生说：我们去公园野餐吧！
explanation.en: The boy suggests it: 我们去公园野餐吧！

items.text: 他们没有去公园野餐，因为中午太热了。

explanation.zh: 女生说：好是好，但是中午太热了！所以改去看电影。
explanation.en: The girl says 中午太热了 — it is too hot at noon — so they change the plan to a movie.

explanation.zh: 男生说去看电影，女生说好啊，先去看看有没有票。
explanation.en: The boy proposes a movie and the girl agrees, if there are tickets.

exercises.title: 选词填空（1）：完、玩、晚
exercises.title_en: Choose the right words to fill in the blanks (1)

note.zh: 三个字读音相近，每句用一个。点句子，再点填进去的字。
note.en: Three characters that sound alike, one per sentence. Tap a sentence, then the character that goes in it.

left: 爸爸，我想和你一起______游戏。

items.left: 爸爸，我想和你一起______游戏。

explanation.zh: 玩游戏：玩 wán。
explanation.en: 玩游戏 — play a game: 玩.

explanation.zh: 这么晚了：晚 wǎn。
explanation.en: 这么晚了 — it is so late: 晚.

explanation.zh: 写完作业：完 wán，做完了。
explanation.en: 写完作业 — finished the homework: 完.

exercises.title: 选词填空（2）：坐、左、做
exercises.title_en: Choose the right words to fill in the blanks (2)

explanation.zh: 左边：左 zuǒ。
explanation.en: 左边 — the left side: 左.

explanation.zh: 坐下来：坐 zuò。
explanation.en: 坐下来 — sit down: 坐.

explanation.zh: 怎么做：做 zuò，做事情。
explanation.en: 怎么做 — how to do it: 做.

exercises.title: 选词填空（3）：狮、是、师

left: 动物园里的______子好可爱啊！

explanation.zh: 这位是我的妈妈：是 shì。
explanation.en: 这位是我的妈妈 — this is my mother: 是.

items.left: 动物园里的______子好可爱啊！

explanation.zh: 狮子：狮 shī。
explanation.en: 狮子 — lion: 狮.

explanation.zh: 老师：师 shī。
explanation.en: 老师 — teacher: 师.

exercises.title: 介绍一个你最感兴趣的景点（四十字以上）
exercises.title_en: Write about a scenic spot that interests you the most, with more than 40 characters

note.zh: 提示：（1）你最想去的地方叫什么名字？（2）那个地方有什么景点？（3）有什么吸引你的地方？（4）你想和哪些人一起去？
note.en: Prompts: (1) What is the place you most want to visit called? (2) What is there to see? (3) What draws you to it? (4) Who would you go with?

exercises.title: 描一描，写一写
exercises.title_en: Trace and write

note.zh: 看旁边的词想字，用笔写出来。点"写好了"以后，标准写法会显示在你写的字下面，对照一下；笔顺按规则判。
note.en: The word beside the box tells you the character; write it with the Pencil. When you tap Done, the standard form appears beneath what you wrote so you can compare; stroke order is judged by rule.

explanation.zh: 肯定：kěn。
explanation.en: 肯定 — kěn, certainly.

explanation.zh: 认输：shū。
explanation.en: 认输 — shū, admit defeat.

explanation.zh: 窄小：zhǎi。
explanation.en: 窄小 — zhǎi, narrow and small.

explanation.zh: 找人：zhǎo。
explanation.en: 找人 — zhǎo, look for someone.

explanation.zh: 批评：píng。
explanation.en: 批评 — píng, criticize.

exercises.title: 上下结构，还是左右结构？
exercises.title_en: Top–bottom structure, or left–right?

explanation.zh: 止在上、月在下：上下结构。
explanation.en: 止 above, 月 below: top–bottom.

explanation.zh: 车在左、俞在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 车 on the left, 俞 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 穴在上、乍在下：上下结构。
explanation.en: 穴 above, 乍 below: top–bottom.

explanation.zh: 扌在左、戈在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 扌 on the left, 戈 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 讠在左、平在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 讠 on the left, 平 on the right: left–right.

exercises.title: 开动脑筋，找一找反义词
exercises.title_en: Think and find the opposite words

note.zh: 点左边的字，再点右边意思相反的字。课本已填好一个：大—小。
note.en: Tap a character on the left, then its opposite on the right. The book has filled one in: 大—小.

explanation.zh: 大的反义词是小——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: The opposite of 大 (big) is 小 (small) — the book's own example.

explanation.zh: 高的反义词是矮：骆驼长得高，羊长得矮。
explanation.en: The opposite of 高 (tall) is 矮 (short): the camel is tall, the sheep is short.

explanation.zh: 宽的反义词是窄：又窄又矮的门。
explanation.en: The opposite of 宽 (wide) is 窄 (narrow), as in the narrow, low door.

explanation.zh: 赢的反义词是输：不肯认输。
explanation.en: The opposite of 赢 (win) is 输 (lose), as in 不肯认输.

explanation.zh: 长的反义词是短：长处和短处。
explanation.en: The opposite of 长 (long) is 短 (short), as in 长处 and 短处.

exercises.title: 看图，选词填空
exercises.title_en: Look at the pictures and choose the right words to fill in the blanks

note.zh: 图在练习册上：前两句在第17页，后两句在第18页。看图，选出填在句子里的词。
note.en: The pictures are in the workbook: the first two sentences on p. 17, the last two on p. 18. Look at each picture and choose the word that fills the blank.

explanation.zh: 图上的动物背上有驼峰，是骆驼，不是马。
explanation.en: The animal in the picture has humps on its back: a camel, 骆驼, not a horse.

explanation.zh: “俩”就是“两个”，可以直接说“他俩”。“两”后面要有量词，要说“他们两个”，不能说“他两”。
explanation.en: 俩 means 'two people' by itself, so 他俩 is 'the two of them'. 两 needs a measure word after it (他们两个); 他两 is not Chinese.

explanation.zh: 衣服的量词是“件”：两件大衣。“牛”是一种动物，不是量词。
explanation.en: 件 is the measure word for clothes: 两件大衣. 牛 is an animal (an ox), not a measure word.

explanation.zh: “高”的反义词是“矮”。图上弟弟比哥哥矮。
explanation.en: The opposite of 高 is 矮, and in the picture the younger brother is the shorter one.

exercises.title: 连一连，组词语
exercises.title_en: Match to form words

note.zh: 先点上面的字，再点下面能和它组成词的字。课本已连好一组：事—情。
note.en: Tap a character on the top row, then the one below that makes a word with it. The book has drawn one line already: 事—情.

explanation.zh: 事—情：事情——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: 事 + 情 = 事情, a matter — the book's own example.

explanation.zh: 证—明：证明。
explanation.en: 证 + 明 = 证明, prove.

explanation.zh: 茂—盛：茂盛。
explanation.en: 茂 + 盛 = 茂盛, lush.

explanation.zh: 旁—边：旁边。
explanation.en: 旁 + 边 = 旁边, beside.

explanation.zh: 围—墙：围墙。
explanation.en: 围 + 墙 = 围墙, an enclosing wall.

exercises.title: 连一连，组词语：把词写下来
exercises.title_en: Match to form words: write the words

note.zh: 连线在前面做过了；这里把四个词各写一遍（课本已写好：事情）。
note.en: The matching was done on the site; here write each of the four words once (the book has written 事情 already).

exercises.title: 连一连，写一写
exercises.title_en: Match and write

note.zh: 课本里先把上面的部件和下面的连起来，再写字；这里直接按部件写出字。马和亻各用两次。课本已连好一组：亻—两，俩。
note.en: The book has you join a part from the top row to one below, then write the character; here write it from the parts given. 马 and 亻 are each used twice. The book has drawn one line already: 亻—两, 俩.

explanation.zh: 亻在左，两在右：俩——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: 亻 on the left, 两 on the right: 俩 — the book's own example.

explanation.zh: 马在左，各在右：骆。
explanation.en: 马 on the left, 各 on the right: 骆.

explanation.zh: 马在左，它在右：驼。
explanation.en: 马 on the left, 它 on the right: 驼.

explanation.zh: 矢在左，委在右：矮。
explanation.en: 矢 on the left, 委 on the right: 矮.

explanation.zh: 亻在左，牛在右：件。
explanation.en: 亻 on the left, 牛 on the right: 件.

explanation.zh: 扌在左，八在右：扒。
explanation.en: 扌 on the left, 八 on the right: 扒.

exercises.title: 根据提示找出部首相同的字
exercises.title_en: Follow the prompts to find the characters with the same radicals

note.zh: 把每个字放进它部首的格子里。课本已写好一个：马——骆。
note.en: Put each character in the box of its radical. The book has placed one already: 马 — 骆.

explanation.zh: 跑的部首是足字旁。
explanation.en: The radical of 跑 is 足, the foot.

explanation.zh: 骆的部首是马——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: The radical of 骆 is 马 — the book's own example.

explanation.zh: 跪的部首是足字旁：跪下用的是腿。
explanation.en: The radical of 跪 is 足: you kneel with your legs.

explanation.zh: 短的部首是矢。
explanation.en: The radical of 短 is 矢.

explanation.zh: 扒的部首是扌：用手扒。
explanation.en: The radical of 扒 is 扌, the hand.

explanation.zh: 矮的部首是矢——课本第39页写着"矢→矮"。
explanation.en: The radical of 矮 is 矢 — the textbook prints 矢 → 矮 on p. 39.

explanation.zh: 找的部首是扌。
explanation.en: The radical of 找 is 扌, the hand.

explanation.zh: 驼的部首是马，和骆一样。
explanation.en: The radical of 驼 is 马, like 骆.

exercises.title: 看图，选择正确的句子
exercises.title_en: Look at the pictures and choose the correct sentences

note.zh: 图在练习册第21页。每组两句，一句对、一句错。
note.en: The pictures are on workbook p. 21. Each pair has one true sentence and one false.

explanation.zh: 图上爸爸高，小明矮：爸爸比小明高。
explanation.en: In the picture the father is the tall one: 爸爸比小明高.

explanation.zh: 矮的是小明，不是爸爸。
explanation.en: The short one is Xiaoming, not his father.

explanation.zh: 夏天热，冬天冷——图上一边是荷花，一边是雪人。
explanation.en: Summer is hot and winter is cold — the lotus and the snowman in the pictures.

explanation.zh: 夏天比冬天热。
explanation.en: Summer is hotter than winter: 夏天比冬天热.

explanation.zh: 十比五大。
explanation.en: Ten is bigger than five: 十比五大.

explanation.zh: 十比五大，不比五小。
explanation.en: Ten is bigger than five, not smaller.

exercises.title: 描一描，写一写
exercises.title_en: Trace and write

note.zh: 看着部件，用笔把字写出来。点"写好了"以后，标准写法会显示在你写的字下面，对照一下；笔顺按规则判。
note.en: Look at the parts and write the character with the Pencil. When you tap Done, the standard form appears beneath what you wrote so you can compare; stroke order is judged by rule.

explanation.zh: 止在上，月在下：肯。
explanation.en: 止 above, 月 below: 肯.

explanation.zh: 穴在上，乍在下：窄。
explanation.en: 穴 above, 乍 below: 窄.

explanation.zh: 足字旁在左，危在右：跪。
explanation.en: 足 on the left, 危 on the right: 跪.

explanation.zh: 钅在左，占在右：钻。
explanation.en: 钅 on the left, 占 on the right: 钻.

explanation.zh: 矢在左，豆在右：短。
explanation.en: 矢 on the left, 豆 on the right: 短.

exercises.title: 上下结构，还是左右结构？
exercises.title_en: Top–bottom structure, or left–right?

explanation.zh: 止在上、月在下：上下结构。
explanation.en: 止 above, 月 below: top–bottom.

explanation.zh: 穴在上、乍在下：上下结构。
explanation.en: 穴 above, 乍 below: top–bottom.

explanation.zh: 足字旁在左、危在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 足 on the left, 危 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 钅在左、占在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 钅 on the left, 占 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 矢在左、豆在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 矢 on the left, 豆 on the right: left–right.

exercises.title: 连一连，组词语
exercises.title_en: Match to form words

note.zh: 先点上面的字，再点下面能和它组成词的字。课本已连好一组：枝—叶。
note.en: Tap a character on the top row, then the one below that makes a word with it. The book has drawn one line already: 枝—叶.

explanation.zh: 枝—叶：枝叶——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: 枝 + 叶 = 枝叶, branches and leaves — the book's own example.

explanation.zh: 抬—头：抬头。
explanation.en: 抬 + 头 = 抬头, raise one's head.

explanation.zh: 自—己：自己。
explanation.en: 自 + 己 = 自己, oneself.

explanation.zh: 短—处：短处。
explanation.en: 短 + 处 = 短处, a weak point.

exercises.title: 连一连，组词语：把词写下来
exercises.title_en: Match to form words: write the words

note.zh: 连线在前面做过了；这里把三个词各写一遍（课本已写好：枝叶）。
note.en: The matching was done on the site; here write each of the three words once (the book has written 枝叶 already).

exercises.title: 照例子，写一写
exercises.title_en: Follow the example and write

note.zh: 例：头 → 抬头、摇头。每个字组两个词。
note.en: Example: 头 → 抬头, 摇头. Make two words with each character.

exercises.title: 动动小脑筋，完成句子
exercises.title_en: Think and complete the sentences

note.zh: 课本的表格：飞机 比 汽车 快；鲨鱼 比 金鱼 大。照这样把下面两句补完整。
note.en: The book's table reads 飞机 比 汽车 快 and 鲨鱼 比 金鱼 大. Complete the two sentences below the same way.

exercises.title: 读一读，选择正确的语句填空
exercises.title_en: Read the text and choose the correct expressions to fill in the blanks

note.zh: 一段话里缺了四句，第一空课本已填好：骆驼认为长得高好。按课文的顺序选。
note.en: Four lines are missing from the passage; the book has filled the first: 骆驼认为长得高好. Choose in the story's order.

options: 你们俩都只看到自己的长处，看不到自己的短处，这是不对的

items.before: 有一天，骆驼和羊聊天。骆驼认为长得高好，______。

explanation.zh: 骆驼说高好，羊说的正相反：羊认为长得矮好。
explanation.en: The camel says tall is better; the sheep says the opposite — 羊认为长得矮好.

items.before: 于是，他们俩分别做了一件事证明自己是对的，谁______，

explanation.zh: 两件事做完，谁都不肯认输。
explanation.en: After both tests, neither would give in: 都不肯认输.

explanation.zh: 最后他们找了老牛评理。
explanation.en: In the end they went to the old ox to judge: 他们找了老牛评理.

explanation.zh: 老牛说的话：你们俩都只看到自己的长处，看不到自己的短处，这是不对的。
explanation.en: The ox's words: you both see only your strengths and not your weaknesses, and that is wrong.

exercises.title: 想一想，写一写
exercises.title_en: Think and write

note.zh: 一个字两个读音，各组一个词。课本给了一半：长 zhǎng 长大；盛 chéng 盛饭；着 zháo 吃不着。
note.en: One character, two readings — a word for each. The book gives half of each pair: 长 zhǎng 长大; 盛 chéng 盛饭; 着 zháo 吃不着.

exercises.title: 根据课文判断正误
exercises.title_en: Decide whether the statements are true or false according to the text

explanation.zh: 课文第一句：骆驼长得高，羊长得矮。
explanation.en: The first line of the text: 骆驼长得高，羊长得矮.

items.text: 羊能吃到围墙外的树叶。

explanation.zh: 羊抬起前腿，扒在墙上，脖子伸得老长，还是吃不着。
explanation.en: The sheep stands on the wall and stretches its neck, and still cannot reach: 还是吃不着.

items.text: 骆驼能钻进又窄又矮的门。

explanation.zh: 骆驼跪下前腿，低下头，往门里钻，怎么也钻不进去。
explanation.en: The camel kneels and lowers its head, and still cannot get through: 怎么也钻不进去.

items.text: 骆驼和羊都只看到了自己的长处。

explanation.zh: 老牛说：你们俩都只看到自己的长处，看不到自己的短处。
explanation.en: The ox says so: 你们俩都只看到自己的长处，看不到自己的短处.

exercises.title: 看图用"……比……"完成句子
exercises.title_en: Look at the picture and complete the sentences with "…bǐ…"

note.zh: 全家福在练习册第26页：爷爷、奶奶、爸爸、妈妈和小朋友。
note.en: The family picture is on workbook p. 26: grandfather, grandmother, father, mother and the child.

exercises.title: 根据提示写一写你的家（四十字以上）
exercises.title_en: Follow the prompts to write about your family, with more than 40 characters

note.zh: 提示：你们家有几口人？分别是谁？谁比你高？谁比妈妈矮？谁的头发比你的长？……
note.en: Prompts: How many people are in your family, and who are they? Who is taller than you? Who is shorter than your mother? Whose hair is longer than yours? …

items.prompt: 写一写你的家（四十字以上）。
items.prompt_en: Write about your family (more than 40 characters).

exercises.title: 根据录音回答问题
exercises.title_en: Listen and answer the questions

note.zh: 请爸爸妈妈读一读练习册第82页第4课的听力文本（或放录音），听完再选。例题书上已经做好：森林深处有一个园子，选A。
note.en: Ask a parent to read the Lesson 4 listening script on workbook p. 82 (or play the recording), then choose. The book has done the example for you: A, a garden.

explanation.zh: 录音说：羊比骆驼矮。课文里也说：骆驼长得高，羊长得矮。
explanation.en: The recording says the sheep is shorter than the camel, as the lesson does: 骆驼长得高，羊长得矮.

explanation.zh: 录音说：坐在“我”旁边的是云云。
explanation.en: The recording says the one sitting beside 'me' is Yunyun: 旁边, not 前边.

explanation.zh: 录音说：“我”喜欢画画儿，画画儿是“我”的长处。唱歌没有说到。
explanation.en: The recording says drawing is what 'I' am good at (长处). Singing is not mentioned.

explanation.zh: 录音说：园子四面有围墙。
explanation.en: The recording says there are walls on all four sides of the garden: 围墙.

explanation.zh: 录音说：围墙上有一个又矮又窄的门。所以骆驼钻不进去。

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：老牛一定会觉得河水很浅。

explanation.zh: 课文第一句就是：小马要过河。
explanation.en: The first line of the text: 小马要过河 — the pony wants to cross the river.

items.text: 老牛说水很浅，因为他又高又大。

explanation.zh: 老牛说"水很浅"；妈妈解释了原因：老牛又高又大，他会觉得水很浅。
explanation.en: The ox says the water is shallow, and Mother explains why: the ox is tall and big, so to him it feels shallow.

items.text: 小松鼠也认为很容易过河。

explanation.zh: 小松鼠说的正相反：别过河！水深得很，你会淹死的。
explanation.en: The squirrel says the opposite: don't cross — the water is very deep, you will drown.

items.text: 小马没有回家问妈妈的建议。

explanation.zh: 小马不知道该怎么办，只好回家问妈妈。
explanation.en: The pony did not know what to do, so he went home and asked his mother.

explanation.zh: 小马又跑到河边，小心地过了河。
explanation.en: The pony went back to the river and crossed it carefully.

exercises.title: 根据课文和图片给句子排序

note.zh: 图在练习册第37页；句子按故事先后排。
note.en: The pictures are on workbook p.37; put the sentences in the story's order.

pieces: 小松鼠从树上跳下来，告诉小马水很深，他会淹死的。
小马跑回家问妈妈，妈妈告诉他最好自己试一试。
小马又跑到河边，小心地过了河。
小马想要过河，牛伯伯告诉他水很浅，过得去。

explanation.zh: 故事的顺序：先问牛伯伯（①），松鼠跳下来（②），回家问妈妈（③），最后小心地过了河（④）。
explanation.en: The story's order: ask the ox first (①), the squirrel jumps down (②), home to ask Mother (③), then across the river carefully (④).

exercises.title: 根据课文判断正误
exercises.title_en: Decide whether the statements are true or false according to the text

items.text: 有一天晚上，一只猴子在树上玩儿。

explanation.zh: 课文说的是"一群猴子在湖边的树上玩儿"，不是一只。
explanation.en: The text says 一群猴子 — a whole group of monkeys was playing in the tree, not one.

items.text: 是小猴子先发现月亮掉到水里的。

explanation.zh: 一只小猴子先喊起来："不好啦，月亮掉到水里了！"大猴子一看，也叫了起来。
explanation.en: A little monkey cries out first — 不好啦，月亮掉到水里了！ — and only then does the big monkey look.

items.text: 只有大猴子想把月亮捞上来。

explanation.zh: 大猴子说"我们把月亮捞上来吧"，于是猴子们都爬到树上，一只拉着一只去捞。
explanation.en: The big monkey says 我们把月亮捞上来吧 — let's — and all the monkeys climb the tree and hang in a chain to do it.

items.text: 猴子们把月亮捞上来了。

explanation.zh: 小猴子的手刚碰到水，月亮就不见了；月亮还在天上呢。
explanation.en: The moment the little monkey's hand touched the water, the moon was gone — it was still up in the sky.

exercises.title: 选择相应的语句补全对话
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct expressions to complete the dialogue

note.zh: 对话里缺了四句，从下面四句里选。
note.en: Four lines are missing from the dialogue; choose each from the four given.

options: 我们一起去机场接爷爷奶奶。
爷爷奶奶不是在北京吗？

items.before: 爸爸：云云，你在哪儿呢？

explanation.zh: 爸爸问在哪儿，云云就说自己在哪儿：我在家呢。
explanation.en: Dad asks where she is, so she says where: 我在家呢 — I'm at home.

items.before: 爸爸：______　云云：在啊。

explanation.zh: 云云回答"在啊"，所以爸爸问的是在不在：妈妈在家吗？
explanation.en: Yunyun answers 在啊 — yes, she is — so Dad's line asks whether someone is there: 妈妈在家吗？

items.before: 爸爸：云云，你和妈妈出来吧！爸爸来接你们，______

explanation.zh: 爸爸来接她们，是要一起去做一件事：我们一起去机场接爷爷奶奶。
explanation.en: Dad is coming to fetch them for a reason: 我们一起去机场接爷爷奶奶 — we're all going to the airport to meet Grandpa and Grandma.

items.before: 云云：嗯？______　爸爸：爷爷奶奶来纽约了。

explanation.zh: 云云很奇怪，她以为爷爷奶奶在北京——这就是这一课的"不是……吗"。爸爸回答：爷爷奶奶来纽约了。
explanation.en: Yunyun is surprised: she thought they were in Beijing. That is this lesson's 不是……吗, and Dad's answer settles it — they have come to New York.

exercises.title: 听录音回答问题
exercises.title_en: Listen and answer the questions

note.zh: 请爸爸妈妈先读练习册第83页第6课听力文本的第2题（或放录音），每句听完再选。例：问：爸爸在哪里？——在家。
note.en: Ask a parent to read item 2 of the Lesson 6 listening script on workbook p. 83 aloud (or play the recording), then choose after each sentence. Example: 问：爸爸在哪里？ — 在家.

explanation.zh: 录音里猴子们说要把月亮捞上来。月亮在水里，要从水里往上捞，所以是"捞上来"，不是"捞下来"。
explanation.en: On the recording the monkeys say they will scoop the moon up. The moon is in the water, and you scoop up out of water: 捞上来, not 捞下来.

explanation.zh: 录音说猫咪总爱趴在"我"的椅子下面，没有说床。
explanation.en: The recording says the cat likes to lie under "my" chair; it says nothing about a bed.

explanation.zh: 录音里用的是这一课的"不是……吗"："我们不是在学校吗？"意思就是"我们在学校"。
explanation.en: The recording uses this lesson's 不是……吗: 我们不是在学校吗？ asks "aren't we at school?", which means we are at school.

items.text: （4）问：“我”刚碰到小狗，它就怎么样了？

explanation.zh: 录音说"我"刚碰到小狗，它就跑了。"刚……就……"是说一碰到，小狗马上就跑了。
explanation.en: On the recording the puppy runs off the moment "I" touch it: 刚……就 means one thing happens and the next follows at once.

exercises.title: 读一读，选一选
exercises.title_en: Read and choose

note.zh: 先读练习册第41页每道题上面的句子，再回答问题。
note.en: First read the lines above each question on workbook p. 41, then answer it.

explanation.zh: 小猴子喊的是"月亮掉到水里了"：掉到水里的是月亮。
explanation.en: The little monkey cries that the moon has fallen into the water: 月亮掉到水里了.

explanation.zh: 挂在最下面的小猴子伸手去捞月亮——最下面的那只离水最近。
explanation.en: The monkey hanging at the very bottom reaches for the moon: 挂在最下面的小猴子, the one closest to the water.

items.text: （2）问题2：小猴子捞月亮的动作是怎样的？

explanation.zh: 课文用的词是"伸手"：把手伸出去捞月亮。
explanation.en: The text's word is 伸手: he stretches his hand out to scoop up the moon.

items.text: （3）问题1：“月亮不是还在天上吗？”这句话是什么意思？

explanation.zh: "不是……吗"用问的样子说一件肯定的事："月亮不是还在天上吗？"意思是月亮还在天上。
explanation.en: 不是……吗 asks a question that means yes: 月亮不是还在天上吗？ means the moon is still in the sky.

explanation.zh: 月亮还在天上，水里的那个只是月亮照在水里的样子，是月亮的倒影。
explanation.en: The moon is still in the sky, so the one in the water is only its picture on the surface: 月亮的倒影, its reflection.

explanation.en: 办 + 法 = 办法, a way to deal with something.

explanation.zh: 扑—通：扑通。
explanation.en: 扑 + 通 = 扑通, splash.

explanation.zh: 聪—明：聪明。
explanation.en: 聪 + 明 = 聪明, clever.

explanation.zh: 惊—慌：惊慌。
explanation.en: 惊 + 慌 = 惊慌, panic.

explanation.zh: 办—法：办法——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: 办 + 法 = 办法, a way to deal with something — the book's own example.

explanation.zh: 使—劲：使劲。
explanation.en: 使 + 劲 = 使劲, use all your strength.

note.en: The matching was done on the site. The book has written sentence (1): 我想到了一个好办法。 Make one sentence with each of the other three words.

exercises.title: 给正确的词语涂色
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct words and color

note.zh: 每句选一个对的词。（练习册上是给它涂上颜色。）
note.en: Pick the right word for each sentence. (In the workbook you color it in.)

explanation.zh: "想出"来的是办法：想出了一个好办法。"希望"是心里盼着的事，不是想出来的。
explanation.en: What you think up is a way to solve something — 办法. 希望 is a hope, not something you work out.

explanation.zh: 后面有"才"，前面就用"只有"：只有……才……。"只要"跟的是"就"。
explanation.en: 才 later in the sentence pairs with 只有: 只有……才…… means only if … can. 只要 pairs with 就.

items.text: （3）我们都是（　）的孩子，都能学好汉语。

explanation.zh: 能学好汉语，说的是聪明：我们都是聪明的孩子。"小心"是留神，跟学得好没有关系。
explanation.en: Learning Chinese well goes with being clever — 聪明. 小心 means careful, which is not what makes you learn well.

explanation.zh: 要砸破又大又深的水缸，得用大力气：课文里说他使劲向水缸砸去。
explanation.en: To break a big, deep vat you have to hit hard — the text says he smashed it 使劲, with all his strength.

exercises.title: 连词成句
exercises.title_en: Write the words in the correct order to make sentences

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：同学们从教室里走出来。
explanation.en: In order: 同学们从教室里走出来 — the classmates walk out of the classroom.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：只有司马光不惊慌。
explanation.en: In order: 只有司马光不惊慌 — only Sima Guang does not panic.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：树下有一个大水缸。
explanation.en: In order: 树下有一个大水缸 — under the tree there is a big water vat.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：他真是个聪明的孩子。这里的"真"是在感叹整句话——他真是个聪明的孩子！所以它放在"是"前面，不放进"聪明的孩子"里。
explanation.en: In order: 他真是个聪明的孩子 — he really is a clever child. Here 真 exclaims about the whole sentence, so it goes before 是, not inside 聪明的孩子.

exercises.title: 根据课文判断正误
exercises.title_en: Decide whether the sentences are true or false according to the text

items.text: 小朋友们在花园里面玩儿，没有听见有人“扑通”一声掉进水缸的声音。

explanation.zh: 课文里说：突然，大家听到“扑通”一声。大家都听见了。
explanation.en: The text says 大家听到“扑通”一声 — everyone heard the splash.

items.text: 水缸又大又深，装满了水。

explanation.zh: 课文里说：水缸又大又深，里面装满了水。
explanation.en: The text says so: 水缸又大又深，里面装满了水 — the vat was big and deep and full of water.

items.text: 小朋友们都哭了，司马光也很惊慌。

explanation.zh: 别的小朋友都吓哭了，只有司马光不惊慌。
explanation.en: The other children cried with fright, but only Sima Guang did not panic: 只有司马光不惊慌.

items.text: 司马光找来一块大石头，使劲向水缸砸去。

explanation.zh: 这就是他想出的办法：找来一块大石头，使劲向水缸砸去。
explanation.en: That was his idea: he found a big stone and smashed it hard against the vat.

items.text: 司马光是个聪明的孩子。

explanation.zh: 课文第一句就说他是一个聪明的孩子；最后大家都说："司马光真聪明！"
explanation.en: The first line calls him a clever child, and at the end everyone says 司马光真聪明 — how clever Sima Guang is.

exercises.title: 选择相应的句子补全对话
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct sentences to complete the dialogue

note.zh: 对话里缺了四句，司马光说三句，小朋友说一句。对话从练习册第49页接到第50页。
note.en: Four lines are missing: three for Sima Guang and one for the children. The dialogue runs from workbook p. 49 onto p. 50.

options: 大家别慌，我来想想办法！
好啊，但是大家要小心一点儿。

items.before: 小朋友：我们一起去花园里玩儿吧！

explanation.zh: 朋友叫他一起去玩儿，他答应了，还提醒大家：好啊，但是大家要小心一点儿。
explanation.en: Asked to come and play, he agrees and reminds everyone to be careful: 好啊，但是大家要小心一点儿.

items.before: （司马光正在和小朋友们玩耍。）小朋友：快来人啊，有人掉到水缸里面了！　司马光：______啊，我想出来了！

explanation.zh: 有人掉进了水缸，他先让大家别慌，再想办法——后面的"啊，我想出来了！"就是想出了办法。
explanation.en: Someone has fallen into the vat; he first tells everyone not to panic and to let him think — then 啊，我想出来了, he has the idea.

items.before: 小朋友：怎么办呢？

explanation.zh: 他的办法要用大石头：快帮我找一块大石头。下一行小朋友就拿来了大石头。
explanation.en: His idea needs a big stone: 快帮我找一块大石头. In the next line the children bring one.

items.before: （小朋友拿来了大石头，司马光拿起石头使劲向水缸砸去。）

explanation.zh: 水缸砸破了，大家夸他：太好了！你真聪明啊！
explanation.en: The vat breaks, and the children praise him: 太好了！你真聪明啊！

exercises.title: 根据课文选择正确的答案，并涂上你喜欢的颜色
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct answers according to the text and color with your favorite color

note.zh: 根据课文选一个答案。（练习册上还要给选中的王冠涂上你喜欢的颜色。）
note.en: Choose the answer from the text. (In the workbook you also color the crown beside it.)

explanation.zh: 课文里说，他和小朋友们在花园里玩儿。
explanation.en: The text says they were playing in the garden: 在花园里玩儿.

explanation.zh: 出的事是：有个小朋友不小心从树上掉进了水缸。有的孩子在爬树，那只是在玩儿。
explanation.en: What happened is that a child slipped from the tree into the vat. Some children were climbing trees, but that was only their game.

explanation.zh: 他找来一块大石头，使劲向水缸砸去。课文里没有去叫大人。
explanation.en: He found a big stone and smashed the vat with it; in the text nobody runs for a grown-up.

explanation.zh: 水缸破了，水流了出来，那个小朋友得救了。
explanation.en: The vat broke, the water ran out, and the child was saved: 得救了.

exercises.title: 连一连
exercises.title_en: Match

note.zh: 左边是问题，右边是回答。先点问题，再点它的回答。
note.en: Questions on the left, answers on the right. Tap a question, then its answer.

right: 因为有人掉到水缸里了。

explanation.zh: 问"为什么"，答"因为……"：有人掉进了水缸，司马光砸缸是为了救他。
explanation.en: A why-question takes a because-answer: someone had fallen into the vat, and Sima Guang broke it to save him.

explanation.zh: 问"用什么"，答的是用的东西：大石头。
explanation.en: Asked what he used, the answer names the thing: a big stone.

explanation.zh: 问"……了吗"，答"救出了"：水流了出来，那个小朋友得救了。
explanation.en: A yes-or-no question about the rescue: yes — the water ran out and the child was saved.

note.zh: 请爸爸妈妈读一读练习册第83页附录里第7课的听力文本（或放录音），听完再选。

explanation.zh: 录音一开头就说了：是星期日去公园野餐的。
explanation.en: The recording says it at the very start: the picnic was on Sunday.

explanation.zh: 录音里去野餐的是爸爸、妈妈、我和弟弟，第（1）题说这是"我们家"去野餐：一共四口人。
explanation.en: The picnic party in the recording is Dad, Mom, me and my little brother, and question (1) calls them 我们家, our family: four people.

explanation.zh: 录音里说，他们九点就出发了。
explanation.en: The recording says they set off at nine o'clock.

explanation.zh: 到了公园，他们看见的是草地和花朵。
explanation.en: At the park they saw grass and flowers.

explanation.zh: 录音里说，他们一起放风筝，玩得非常开心。
explanation.en: The recording says they flew a kite together and had a great time.

exercises.title: 读短文，判断对错
exercises.title_en: Read the passage and decide whether the statements are true or false

note.zh: 短文《乌鸦喝水》在练习册第53–54页。先读短文，再判断对错。
note.en: The passage 乌鸦喝水 is on workbook pp. 53–54. Read it first, then mark each sentence.

explanation.zh: 短文一开头，乌鸦就渴了，正到处找水。
explanation.en: Right at the start of the passage the crow is thirsty and out looking for water.

explanation.zh: 瓶子里面有半瓶水，只是乌鸦喝不着。
explanation.en: The bottle was half full of water; the crow just could not reach it.

explanation.zh: 短文里说乌鸦"喝不着"——"喝不着"就是"喝不到"。
explanation.en: The passage says the crow 喝不着 — and 喝不着 means the same as 喝不到, could not get a drink.

explanation.zh: 最后乌鸦用小石子让水升高，喝到了水。
explanation.en: In the end the crow used pebbles to make the water rise, and it did get its drink.

explanation.zh: 娄在左，攵在右：数。

explanation.zh: 果在左，页在右：颗。

explanation.en: 娄 on the left, 攵 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 告在上、非在下：上下结构。

explanation.zh: 亻在左、卬在右：左右结构。

explanation.zh: 果在左、页在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 果 on the left, 页 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 图上是蓝天、白云和飞着的小鸟——天空。

explanation.zh: 句和勺都有"勹"，部首相同。

explanation.zh: 衡和街都把中间的部分夹在"彳"和"亍"中间，部首相同。

exercises.title: 找出结构相同的字

explanation.zh: 娄在左、攵在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 娄 on the left, 攵 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 告在上、非在下：上下结构。

explanation.zh: 亻在左、卬在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 亻 on the left, 卬 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 果在左、页在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 果 on the left, 页 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 辶从左边包到下面，车在里面：半包围结构。
explanation.en: 辶 wraps round the left and the bottom with 车 inside: half-enclosed.

explanation.zh: 辶从左边包到下面，元在里面：半包围结构。
explanation.en: 辶 wraps round the left and the bottom with 元 inside: half-enclosed.

explanation.zh: 日在上、生在下：上下结构。
explanation.en: 日 above, 生 below: top–bottom.

explanation.zh: 奴在上、力在下：上下结构。
explanation.en: 奴 above, 力 below: top–bottom.

exercises.title: 根据课文判断正误
exercises.title_en: Decide whether the statements are true or false according to the text

explanation.zh: 像勺子的是北斗星：七颗星连起来像一把勺子。北极星是离北斗星不远的那颗星。
explanation.en: It is the Big Dipper, 北斗星, that looks like a spoon — seven stars joined up. 北极星 is the one star not far from it.

items.text: 天上有很多星星，张衡数不完。

explanation.zh: 课文说：他一颗一颗地数，数了很久，还是数不完。
explanation.en: The text says so: he counted them one by one for a long time and still could not finish — 还是数不完.

items.text: 张衡是一千九百多年前的中国人。

explanation.zh: 课文说：这个数星星的孩子叫张衡，是一千九百多年前的中国人。
explanation.en: The text says so: the boy was Zhang Heng, who lived in China more than 1,900 years ago.

items.text: 张衡长大后成了著名的发明家。

explanation.zh: 课文说张衡长大后成了著名的天文学家，没有说发明家。
explanation.en: The text says he grew up to be a famous astronomer, 天文学家; it does not say inventor.

exercises.title: 选择正确的词语完成句子
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct words to complete the sentences

note.zh: 每句从括号里的两个中选一个。例：他在（数✓　书）星星。
note.en: Choose one of the two in the brackets for each sentence. Example: 他在（数✓　书）星星。

items.text: （1）小时候我喜欢（　）着妈妈听故事。

explanation.zh: "靠着"是身体挨着，像课文里张衡靠着奶奶。"告"是告诉的"告"，没有"告着"。
explanation.en: 靠着 means leaning against someone, as Zhang Heng leans on his grandmother in the text. 告 is the 告 of 告诉, to tell; there is no 告着.

items.text: （2）哥哥很高，我要（　）着头和他说话。

explanation.zh: "仰着头"是把头抬起来往上看——哥哥高，要抬头看他。课文里张衡也是仰着头数星星。"样"是样子的"样"。
explanation.en: 仰着头 is tipping your head back to look up — the brother is tall, so you look up at him, as Zhang Heng 仰着头 to count the stars. 样 is the 样 of 样子, a look or shape.

explanation.zh: "颗"数星星这种小而圆的东西：一颗星。"棵"是木字旁，数树：一棵树。课文说：他一颗一颗地数。
explanation.en: 颗 counts small round things like stars: 一颗星. 棵, with 木 for wood, counts trees: 一棵树. The text says 他一颗一颗地数.

explanation.zh: "看不清"是看不清楚。"睛"是眼睛的"睛"，不能放在"看不"后面。
explanation.en: 看不清 means cannot see clearly. 睛 is the 睛 of 眼睛, the eye, and cannot follow 看不.

note.zh: 例：张衡靠着奶奶数星星。云云靠着妈妈听故事。每一题上面一行是例句，照它换上别的词，写出自己的句子。
note.en: Example: 张衡靠着奶奶数星星。云云靠着妈妈听故事。 In each one the top line is the model; swap in words of your own and write the sentence.

explanation.zh: 课文第一句：夏天的夜晚，天空布满了明亮的星星。
explanation.en: The text's first line: 夏天的夜晚，天空布满了明亮的星星 — a summer night.

explanation.zh: 课文说：一个孩子坐在院子里，靠着奶奶，仰着头数天上的星星。
explanation.en: The text says the boy sat in the yard: 一个孩子坐在院子里.

explanation.zh: 爷爷说：那七颗星连起来像一把勺子，那是北斗星。北极星是离它不远的那颗星。
explanation.en: Grandpa says the seven stars joined up look like a spoon, and that is 北斗星. 北极星 is the one star not far from it.

explanation.zh: 课文说：张衡是一千九百多年前的中国人。
explanation.en: The text says Zhang Heng lived in China more than 1,900 years ago: 一千九百多年前的中国人.

exercises.title: 读一读，选择正确的句子
exercises.title_en: Read and choose the correct sentences

note.zh: 每个问题选一句话来回答。例子课本已填好：宝贝长大后想做什么呢？——我长大后想做一名医生。
note.en: Choose the sentence that answers each question. The book has done the example: 宝贝长大后想做什么呢？ — 我长大后想做一名医生。

options: 我长大后想做一名医生。

items.before: 例：宝贝长大后想做什么呢？

explanation.zh: 问长大后想做什么，答：我长大后想做一名医生——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: Asked what she wants to be when she grows up, the answer is 我长大后想做一名医生 — the book's own example.

items.before: （1）你在做什么？

explanation.zh: 问在做什么，答正在做的事：我在数星星。
explanation.en: Asked what he is doing, he says what he is doing now: 我在数星星。

items.before: （2）那么多星星，你能数得清吗？

explanation.zh: 问数得清数不清，答：看得见就数得清。课文里张衡说的是：看得见就能数得清。
explanation.en: Asked whether he can count them all, the answer is 看得见就数得清 — if I can see them, I can count them. In the text Zhang Heng says 看得见就能数得清.

items.before: （3）那七颗星连起来像什么？

explanation.zh: 问像什么，答：像一把勺子。那七颗星就是北斗星。
explanation.en: Asked what they look like: 像一把勺子, like a spoon. Those seven stars are the Big Dipper.

items.before: （4）离北斗星不远的那颗星叫什么呢？

explanation.zh: 问那颗星叫什么，答：那颗星叫北极星。
explanation.en: Asked what that star is called: 那颗星叫北极星, the Pole Star.

explanation.zh: 日在左，尧在右：晓。

explanation.zh: 目在左，民在右：眠。

explanation.zh: 口在左，帝在右：啼。

explanation.zh: 忄在左，闵在右：悯。
explanation.en: 忄 on the left, 闵 on the right: 悯.

explanation.zh: 纟在左，申在右：绅。

explanation.zh: 米在左，立在右：粒。

explanation.en: 比 above, 白 below: 皆.

explanation.zh: 目在左、民在右：左右结构。

explanation.zh: 米在左、立在右：左右结构。

note.zh: 先写部首，再写笔画数或者那一笔的名字（比如：横、竖、撇、点、横折）。
note.en: Write the radical first, then the number of strokes or the name of that stroke (such as 横, 竖, 撇, 点, 横折).

items.prompt_en: (1) The radical of 闻 is ＿＿, and it has ＿＿ strokes.
(2) The radical of 皆 is ＿＿, and its fourth stroke is ＿＿.
(3) The radical of 辛 is ＿＿, and it has ＿＿ strokes.
(4) The radical of 苦 is ＿＿, and its seventh stroke is ＿＿.

exercises.title: 选出带有下列偏旁部首的字
exercises.title_en: Select the characters with the following radicals

note.zh: 课本的例子：纟——抗、红、块，勾的是"红"。每行三个字，带有这个偏旁部首的就勾上。这里每个字判断一次：带有，选"对"；不带，选"错"。
note.en: The book's example: 纟 — 抗, 红, 块, and 红 is ticked. Each row has three characters; tick the ones that have the radical. Here each character is one true-or-false: true if it has it, false if not.

explanation.zh: 晓的左边是日字旁，不是目：日＋尧。
explanation.en: 晓 has 日, the sun, on the left — not 目, the eye: 日 + 尧.

explanation.zh: 皆是比在上、白在下，里面没有目。
explanation.en: 皆 is 比 over 白; there is no 目 in it.

explanation.zh: 眠的左边是目字旁：睡觉要闭上眼睛。
explanation.en: 眠 has 目 on the left: you close your eyes to sleep.

explanation.zh: 闻是门字框，里面是耳：门＋耳。
explanation.en: 闻 is 耳 inside 门, so it has 门.

explanation.zh: 国的外面是四面围起来的囗，不是门。
explanation.en: 国 is closed in on all four sides by 囗, not by 门.

explanation.zh: 凶的外面是凵，从下面包着，不是门。
explanation.en: 凶 is held from below by 凵, not by 门.

explanation.zh: 滴的左边是三点水（氵）：水滴是水，不是金属。
explanation.en: 滴 has 氵, the water radical — a drop is water — not 钅.

explanation.zh: 铁的左边是金字旁（钅）：铁是一种金属。
explanation.en: 铁 has 钅, the metal radical: iron is a metal.

items.text: （1）锄禾日当午　画线的字："日"

explanation.zh: 锄禾日当午：太阳正在头顶上，正是中午。这里的"日"是太阳。
explanation.en: 锄禾日当午: the sun is right overhead, so it is noon. Here 日 is the sun.

items.text: （2）春眠不觉晓　画线的字："晓"

explanation.zh: 春眠不觉晓：春天睡得香，不知道天已经亮了。"晓"是天亮，《春晓》写的就是春天的早上。
explanation.en: 春眠不觉晓: sleeping soundly in spring, not noticing it is already light. 晓 is daybreak, and 春晓 is a spring morning.

items.text: （3）处处闻啼鸟　画线的字："闻"

explanation.zh: 处处闻啼鸟：到处都听见鸟叫。鸟叫是用耳朵听的——"闻"里面就有一个"耳"。今天常说用鼻子闻，可在这句古诗里，"闻"是听见。
explanation.en: 处处闻啼鸟: birdsong is heard everywhere. You hear birds with your ears, and there is an 耳 inside 闻. Today 闻 usually means to smell, but in this old poem it means to hear.

items.text: （4）粒粒皆辛苦　画线的字："皆"

explanation.zh: 粒粒皆辛苦：每一粒都是辛苦换来的。"皆"就是"都"。
explanation.en: 粒粒皆辛苦: every single grain came from hard work. 皆 means all, 都.

items.text: （2）《春晓》中哪一句是写“人们到处都能听见小鸟的啼叫声”？

exercises.title: 读课文，判断正误
exercises.title_en: Read the text and decide whether the statements are true or false

items.text: 《春晓》和《悯农》这两首诗都是唐代诗人写的。

explanation.zh: 课本上两首诗都标着（唐）：孟浩然和李绅都是唐代诗人。
explanation.en: Both poems are marked （唐） in the book: 孟浩然 and 李绅 were both Tang-dynasty poets.

items.text: “春眠不觉晓”这句的意思是：春天的时候睡觉，天亮了还不知道。

explanation.zh: 春眠是春天睡觉，不觉晓是不知道天已经亮了。
explanation.en: 春眠 is sleeping in spring, and 不觉晓 is not noticing that it is already light.

items.text: “谁知盘中餐”这句的意思是：谁都不知道盘子去哪儿了。

explanation.zh: "盘中餐"是盘子里的饭菜，下一句接着说"粒粒皆辛苦"——每一粒都来得很辛苦。诗里没有说盘子去哪儿了。
explanation.en: 盘中餐 is the food on the plate, and the next line goes on: 粒粒皆辛苦, every grain of it came from hard work. Nothing in the poem is about where a plate went.

items.text: 《悯农》这首诗是让我们知道农民伯伯种地辛苦，要好好珍惜粮食。

explanation.zh: 前两句写农民中午还在锄地，汗滴到土里；后两句说每一粒粮食都来得辛苦，所以要珍惜。
explanation.en: The first two lines show the farmer hoeing at noon with his sweat dripping into the soil; the last two say every grain was hard to grow, so we should not waste food.

items.before: 朵朵：方方，我来考考你，你知道《悯农》这首诗里哪一句是写农民伯伯中午还在劳作，汗水都滴落在田里的吗？　方方：我知道，是“______”。

explanation.zh: 写农民中午还在劳作、汗水滴在田里的，是前两句：锄禾日当午，汗滴禾下土。
explanation.en: The farmer still working at noon with his sweat dripping on the field is the first two lines: 锄禾日当午，汗滴禾下土.

items.before: 朵朵：那你知道“谁知盘中餐，粒粒皆辛苦”是什么意思吗？　方方：______。

explanation.zh: 问的是这两句的意思，回答就从"意思是"说起：谁知道我们盘中的粮食，每一粒都是农民的辛苦换来的。
explanation.en: She asks what the two lines mean, so the answer starts 意思是: who knows that every grain on our plate was earned by the farmers' hard work.

items.before: 朵朵：你知道这首诗想要告诉我们什么吗？　方方：这首诗想要告诉我们______。

explanation.zh: 这首诗想告诉我们的道理：农民伯伯劳作不容易，我们要珍惜粮食。
explanation.en: What the poem wants to tell us: the farmers' work is hard, so we should treasure our food.
